title: Copilot code review
description: Automatic Copilot code review of pull requests, managed through the rulesets API. Mutually exclusive with a manually managed 'Copilot Code Review' ruleset. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#copilot_code_review

enabled.description: Whether Copilot automatically reviews pull requests.

review_on_push.description: Re-review when new commits are pushed.
